title: Activities for young people
intro: Toynbee Hall works with young people and families in Tower Hamlets through community activities, wellbeing workshops and youth-led research.

blocks.heading: Thriving Together
paragraphs: This co-designed programme for young people aged 14–22 and their families builds community connections, provides practical mental health and financial wellbeing support, and creates safe spaces for communication and peer learning.

blocks.heading: Get involved
paragraphs: To find out about current activities or opportunities to take part, email research@toynbeehall.org.uk.
